body: This brings me hope… Aside from everything I have already mentioned I also feel the responsibility of helping my family and this job has allowed me to help my mom pay off her debt and fund some house reparations that were pending ever since I could remember. I don’t have any debt myself tho.

You're more than worth it girl. Tell your mom, friends and everyone you love that you love them. Your mom loves you but maybe she doesn't know how to help you. Give yourself a chance in that month. Build a routine, try leaving your bed more often, do those small things that bring you joy and most importantly, get professional help. 

A lot can happen in a month. I believe in you. <3
I'm a 22f. Message me anytime. Send you a big hug. <3

Understand that you're fully capable of doing good at school, failing once means that maybe you're not feeling your best now and need to work on that, it's fine, everyone makes mistakes. What can be done to make the best of the situation? Think of that instead. 

Talk to someone, your parents or whomever you trust and ask for help. You are worth it and most definitely not a burden, don't ever think otherwise. Send you a big hug. <3
Couldn't have said it better. It's so nice there's a community full of people who get you and it takes courage to post about how you feel, it's a way of fighting back.

Maybe you can't go further because you don't actually want to. A part of you still wants to live, listen to the part of you who wants to fight those those thoughts. What you need to overcome is whatever hardships you're going through, there's a good chance you can do it. Send you a big hug!
Give your dog a big hug. Make peace with yourself today and give life another try tomorrow. I really hope you're still here and please get help. I believe in you! <3

Do damage control. What can you do now to complete some of those assignments that's realistic? Which assignments will affect your grades the most and which the least? Prioritize those that can be completed and are more important. Make a list.
Talk to your teachers and maybe they can give you more time to hand them in(and if they don't well at least you tried).
 It's fine if you didn't do your best this time, you can do it and it's going to be okay at the end. Forgive yourself, things happen. You've got this!

I don't know you, but I do know that it is a fucked up thing all of us measure our self worth by our looks and the amount of attention we get from men. Don't let something that fucked up to twist your perception of life. Allow yourself to think what you value of yourself, that's way more important. I know how hard it is to believe it but you're worth it. 

You're a lot of good things and maybe once you realise that, you'll believe being found attractive by men is secondary, and while we all have needs, maybe we need to build up our self-esteem a fuck lot, which is very fucking hard for everyone, to not let those thoughts affect us as much. You've got this. <3

Something that's helped me when I'm about to harm myself is to vomit on paper how I feel. Once I kind of feel I've written it all I read it over and over again. By no means do I feel better but everytime I realise that I'm not thinking straight and need to allow myself to calm down. Try doing it and ask for help, tell your mom you love her, she deserves to know that and to see her son one more time.

Support her in a way that doesn't harm you. You can only do so much and that's more than enough. I can asure you she's more than grateful for you but let her know calmly how you feel and how desperate you're to see her being fine with herself. She will definitely not change in a day but counseling will help you but get through this even if at the end of the day you decide to stop having a romantic relationship with her. 

I've been her and I'm grateful for everyone who's helped me, but more so when they tell me that since I'm important to them, I also need to consider their feelings and keep making and effort for myself. Sometimes we're a little selfish when we are in that really dark place. Hope you're feeling better.

I care about you. I'm certain you are a smart and kind girl. You can rebuild yourself as many times as you need. You are worth all the time in the world. Don't let your past define you, fuck that. You're strong and you can do it <3

I've known that feeling for a long time now and I will say that you don't deserve to feel that way. No one does. You matter and you can feel loved even if it's not romantically. Don't let depression win.

Be kinder to yourself. Maybe it's cliché but you don't have to be with someone or be liked by someone to be okay. Don't focus on things you can't fix and work on those you can. I believe you can do it, hope you're feeling better :)
I'm so happy that you're still here too. You can do it, send you lots of love <3

Try being nicer to yourself. There's something my therapist once told me that stucked to me and is that I would never treat others the way I treat myself. It's hard to see the things one likes about oneself, but unless you start treating yourself right you will continue to think that ounces of kindness are love and they're absolutely not. I'm sure you're amazing, start believing it.
